explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration matching this theorem. It says that for a basis of group-like elements, an element x satisfies comul x = x ⊗ x exactly when its coordinates form orthogonal idempotents. Mathlib/RingTheory/Coalgebra/GroupLike.lean has only basic facts about IsGroupLikeElem and the linear independence of group-like elements; nothing there uses a basis or its coordinates (`repr`). OrthogonalIdempotents shows up only in RingTheory/Idempotents, DirectSum/Idempotents, Smooth/Pi and Etale/QuasiFinite, none of which mentions coalgebras. A grep for comul applied to basis vectors found nothing. The current proof works directly from coordinate computations and the library's own lemma `tensorProduct_repr_comul_apply`.
